episodes.synopsis: Emma has traveled to the faraway village of Haworth to start a new life. Now employed by the wealthy Mölders family, she finds herself faced with an eccentric mistress and surrounded by dozens of other servants.
episodes.title: A New House

episodes.synopsis: William, still recovering from the loss of Emma, receives an invitation from Eleanor to visit the crystal palace. Will he be able to escape the memories that haunt him there?
episodes.title: Moonlight

episodes.synopsis: Emma accompanies Dorothea to visit a mysterious woman known only as “Mrs. Trollope.” Meanwhile, William goes to see a play in his ill sister’s stead, but a surprise awaits him there…
episodes.title: Cool Rain

episodes.synopsis: The Mölders family will soon travel to their house in London. They ordinarily take a few servants along, and Emma is afraid she might be picked for the position.
episodes.title: Courtship

episodes.synopsis: Mrs. Trollope asks Emma to join her at her son’s engagement party, as an attendant. Mrs. Molders decides that Emma will go, but it’s a decision that Emma might soon regret.
episodes.title: Embrace

episodes.synopsis: William’s heart has been thrown into turmoil. In an attempt to calm him, William’s mother tells him about her past, along with what happened between her and Richard.
episodes.title: Success and Loss

episodes.synopsis: William’s decision is made: he’s going to call off the engagement. But such harsh actions will have harsh consequences, especially where Viscount Campbell is involved.
episodes.title: Evening Waves

episodes.synopsis: Distraught at what’s happened to the Jones family and blaming herself for it all, Emma runs away. But Hans follows after her, determined to bring her home.
episodes.title: Whereabouts

episodes.synopsis: The decision to call off the engagement is slowly breaking the Jones family apart. And to make matters worse, Viscount Campbell has set a terrible scheme into motion...
episodes.title: Resolution

episodes.synopsis: William now knows the location of the Mölders house, and of Emma. He heads there with a purpose, but how will Emma react when she sees him?
episodes.title: By the Window

episodes.synopsis: The Viscount’s plan was carried out flawlessly, and now the Jones family faces financial ruin. There are only a few days left to save the railway project, and the company itself.
episodes.title: Time

episodes.synopsis: Fire breaks out at the Mölders’ home, and Emma rushes to help! Meanwhile, William has his hands tied trying to save the family business; today is the last day before the railway project is closed. But today is also the day when Emma and William must either meet at the fountain, or never again… When the appointed time comes, what will they choose?
episodes.title: Flower
